scope: H1 execution failure ownership; no milestone, API, full-system or physical-clock completion claim.

contract.executionFault_input: Accepted task trap, failed kernel completion or accepted staging response fault belonging to the resident owner; pulse, not sticky historical state.
contract.drain: Close the pass, suppress new local updates, drain already offered/issued work and every producer before releasing context/pass/generation.
contract.shaderFault_output: Also reports failed fragment completions and staging faults to the existing host failure path.
contract.failed_pass: A failure does not roll back attachment writes that had already completed; dependent consumers must observe the failed status.

shared_boundary_cases: accepted trap followed by failed completion
staging write fault and staging read fault
successful context/pass/generation reuse after every failed lifetime
final image and zero failed-pass stores before end
two simultaneously executing worker tasks with tagged replies
shared_boundary_executor_scope: The boundary harness copies ABI input color/depth to outputs; it does not execute instructions. RenderPipelineSpec separately retains actual CU-executed image checks at all sample modes. Integration with the full shared system CU pool and VM/cache publication is still pending.
legacy_staging_fixes: Wait for the producer write pipe before capturing the first quad of a one-quad batch.
Keep ceil(log2(batch capacity)) index bits for non-power-of-two capacities.
Suppress launch after legacy-word input staging faults and suppress all batch outputs after output staging faults.
Verify 4/8/12/16/112/128 fragment capacities, response reorder/backpressure, exact one-cycle fault-event counts and healthy reuse.

performance.scope: Unchanged fixed32 word-latency/eight-request-window component model; not DRAM/AXI or frame FPS.

gate.scope: All reported synthesis setup paths, including I/O

physical.route: Latest execution-fault input is not route-qualified. Separate live registered-event route is frozen before this change.
physical.scope: TC/SLVT, 1000 ps, 25% I/O-delay budget and characterized SRAM; component synthesis estimate, not integrated GPU qualification.

remaining: host command/VM integration and cache-domain publication
texture fault and broader protected execution contracts
